# Fingerprint of the OpenPGP primary key that signs release tags (docs/04 §7).
#
# bin/verify-release-tag.sh reads this file from main and accepts a release tag only if the
# public key in the repository variable RELEASE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY has a primary fingerprint
# listed here. Replacing the variable alone therefore authorises no other key: a new key
# needs a reviewed pull request that changes this file.
#
# One fingerprint per line, 40 hexadecimal digits (or 64 for a version 5 key), spaces allowed,
# as printed by: gpg --fingerprint --with-colons KEY | awk -F: '$1=="fpr" {print $10; exit}'
# Text after # is a comment. No release key is pinned yet, so every release tag is refused.
